title: ESPECIALISTA SEGURANCA INFORMACAO
description:
A Prudential é uma empresa global de 150 anos de história com presença em mais de 50 países e estamos há mais de 27 anos ajudando a minimizar o impacto financeiro que um imprevisto pode representar na vida de milhares de famílias brasileiras. Somos a maior seguradora independente no segmento de vida e tivemos uma média de crescimento de 27% de faturamento no país nos últimos 10 anos. Com crescimento sólido, reputação global e líder de mercado, nos dedicamos a oferecer soluções inovadoras e personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para nossos clientes.

MOVIDOS POR PROTEGER, INSPIRADOS POR PESSOAS

Aqui na Prudential, oferecemos soluções personalizadas de seguros de vida individual e em grupo para milhões de brasileiros. Nosso propósito e crescimento acelerado nos posicionaram como a maior seguradora independente no segmento de pessoas (excluindo VGBL). É com muito orgulho que alcançamos mais de 5 milhões de vidas protegidas no Brasil. Com 150 anos de atuação no mundo, a Prudential tem operações nos Estados Unidos, Ásia, Europa e América Latina.

A Prudential do Brasil é um lugar para realizar em meio a um time que valoriza a colaboração. Se nosso símbolo é o rochedo, a nossa força são nossas pessoas, suas histórias e seu repertório. Conheça um pouco mais sobre nós clicando aqui.

SOBRE A POSIÇÃO:

Especialista de Segurança da Informação

Profissional para liderar tecnicamente em iniciativas estratégicas, com foco em Segurança da Informação, em ambientes complexos de múltiplas tecnologias, dados sensíveis, Inteligência Artificial e operações data driven, com atuação em times globais.

No dia a dia, você será desafiado(a) a:

  • Coordenar a execução da estratégia de Segurança da Informação , garantindo a proteção de dados, sistemas, modelos de IA e ativos digitais, alinhado a frameworks como ISO 27001, ISO 27701, PCI DSS, Zero Trust e práticas modernas de Governança de IA.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e ponto focal na integração entre Segurança, Tecnologia e Negócio, assegurando que iniciativas sejam seguras, éticas, auditáveis e em conformidade regulatória.
  • Implementar e manter boas práticas de segurança em projetos corporativos, alinhados a padrões internacionais e requisitos internos.
  • Apoiar a governança de privacidade e proteção de dados pessoais , garantindo aderência à LGPD, ISO 27701 e demais regulamentações, especialmente em ambientes analíticos e de IA.
  • Recomendar e supervisionar controles de segurança em projetos/iniciativas que processam dados sensíveis e financeiros, incluindo segmentação, acessos, monitoramento e gestão de vulnerabilidades.
  • Promover o modelo de Zero Trust , aplicando princípios como verificação contínua de identidade, privilégio mínimo e segmentação de redes em ambientes de dados, cloud, APIs e plataformas de IA.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de governança de IA , definindo controles de segurança para modelos e algoritmos, mitigando riscos de viés, uso indevido e vazamento de informações.
  • Coordenar times técnicos e fornecedores , garantindo alinhamento e adesão ao Security by design.
  • Apoiar a evolução da arquitetura segura de dados e IA , em ambientes cloud, on-premises ou híbridos.
  • Promover a cultura de segurança e uso responsável de IA , disseminando boas práticas junto às áreas de tecnologia e negócio.
  • Atuar em colaboração com times globais , garantindo integração e alinhamento de práticas de segurança em escala internacional.

Requisitos e qualificações

Necessário:

  • Experiência sólida em Segurança da Informação, com atuação em ambientes corporativos complexos e integração com times de tecnologia, dados e negócio.
  • Conhecimento prático e conceitual em:
    • ISO/IEC 27001 – SGSI, gestão de riscos e controles de segurança
    • ISO/IEC 27701 – governança de privacidade e proteção de dados
    • PCI DSS – segurança de ambientes que processam dados de pagamento
    • Zero Trust Architecture – identidade, acesso, segmentação e monitoramento
    • Inteligência Artificial e IA Generativa – riscos e controles de segurança
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos técnicos e regulatórios em orientações claras e aplicáveis ao negócio.
  • Experiência na coordenação de equipes técnicas, fornecedores e stakeholders, com foco em governança, mitigação de riscos e entrega de valor.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, com visão sistêmica, senso de responsabilidade e orientação a resultados.
  • Inglês fluente, para atuação em projetos e colaboração com times globais.

Pilares de atuação

  • Governança e Compliance – Liderar e garantir conformidade dos projetos com frameworks de segurança, privacidade e IA.
  • Gestão de Riscos – Avaliar riscos específicos de iniciativas envolvendo tecnologia, dados e IA.
  • Inovação Segura e Sustentável – Equilibrar adoção de novas tecnologias com práticas robustas de segurança e governança.

Aqui você tem flexibilidade com nosso modelo de trabalho remoto . Essa posição será baseada no Rio de Janeiro .

NA PRUDENTIAL, VOCÊ PODE CONTAR COM:

title: Consultor/a de Doenças Raras - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Consultor/a de Doenças Raras - Rio de Janeiro

A sua missão será:

Promover os produtos por meio de interações científicas qualificadas, fortalecendo o relacionamento com pneumologistas, reumatologistas e demais stakeholders do ecossistema de fibrose pulmonar. Identificar oportunidades para otimizar diagnóstico, jornada do paciente e acesso ao tratamento. Atuar como articulador do sistema de saúde, apoiando a estruturação de Centros de Referência e contribuindo para soluções de acesso público e privado. Executar visitas científicas, projetos educacionais, eventos e ações cross‑funcionais para ampliar o uso adequado da terapia e acelerar a identificação de pacientes elegíveis. Analisar dados de mercado e território, monitorar desempenho e garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais, científicas e de acesso. Atuar sempre com excelência, ética e conformidade regulatória.

Papéis e Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar interações científicas regulares e de alto nível com pneumologistas, reumatologistas, hospitais e Centros de Referência para promover conhecimento técnico-científico sobre fibrose pulmonar e diferenciais de produto.
  • Identificar oportunidades para ampliar diagnóstico, elegibilidade e adoção clínica, desenvolvendo demanda de forma ética e orientada à ciência.
  • Compreender os gargalos da jornada do paciente, apoiar a implementação das soluções internas de acesso e propor novas iniciativas para remover barreiras regionais.
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com médicos, gestores, sociedades científicas e outros stakeholders relevantes, entendendo suas necessidades e expectativas.
  • Participar e organizar eventos, reuniões clínicas, boards e projetos de educação médica que ampliem o awareness da doença e fortaleçam o posicionamento da marca.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre diretrizes, estudos, evidências clínicas e tendências do ecossistema de saúde público e privado relacionadas à fibrose pulmonar.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos sobre atividades, resultados e perspectivas, analisando dados de território, mercado, indicadores epidemiológicos e outras para orientar ajustes estratégicos.
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais, como desenvolvimento de Centros de Referência, iniciativas de diagnóstico, ações de expansão e orquestração e implementação de Planos de contas.
  • Atuar em conformidade com normas de farmacovigilância, políticas internas, compliance e diretrizes legais, assegurando integridade em todas as interações.
  • Garantir a qualidade do cadastro de clientes, contas e stakeholders, mantendo informações atualizadas para suportar a tomada de decisão.
  • Executar e co-construir estratégias e educação médica continuada, contribuindo para capacitação dos profissionais de saúde.
  • Elaborar e orquestrar planos estratégicos para contas-chave, incluindo análise de cenário, definição de prioridades, estruturação de estratégia e acompanhamento rigoroso da execução para garantir impacto e sustentabilidade das ações.
  • Acompanhar e analisar dados de mercado, tendências clínicas e indicadores de desempenho para embasar priorizações e decisões estratégicas.

E o que você precisa para cumprir a sua missão?

  • Formação em nível superior, sendo preferencialmente Marketing, Farmácia, Administração de empresas além de ciências biológicas no geral.
  • Sólida experiência na indústria farmacêutica e mercados de doenças raras ou correlatas preferencialmente na pneumologia ou reumatologia.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes conforme demandas do território.
  • Conhecimentos em doenças fibrosantes pulmonares (fibrose pulmonar progressiva FPP, fibrose pulmonar idiopática FPI e doenças de base reumatológicas), diretrizes clínicas e principais evidências científicas.
  • Domínio do ecossistema de saúde público e privado, incluindo PCDTs, fluxos do SUS, protocolos institucionais e processos de acesso.
  • Capacidade de mapear a jornada do paciente e identificar barreiras e oportunidades para diagnóstico e tratamento.

Deve interpretar manuais técnicos, seguir normas de segurança e ambientais, e utilizar corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos homologados, contribuindo diretamente para a satisfação do cliente e o desempenho do pós-vendas da concessionária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos BYD conforme ordem de serviço.
  • Efetuar troca de óleo e filtros (óleo do motor, ar do motor, ar-condicionado, combustível).
  • Executar alinhamento e balanceamento de rodas com equipamentos adequados.
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas e eletrônicas utilizando scanner automotivo homologado pela montadora.
  • Executar serviços mecânicos nos sistemas:
  • Suspensão: substituição de amortecedores, bandejas, buchas, molas, pivôs e bieletas.
  • Freios: troca de pastilhas, discos, lonas, tambores, cilindros, sangria do sistema e verificação do fluido.
  • Direção: manutenção de caixas de direção mecânica ou elétrica, terminais e barras de direção.
  • Arrefecimento: troca de bomba d’água, reservatório, válvula termostática, mangueiras e verificação de vazamentos.
  • Transmissão: substituição de homocinéticas, semieixos, retentores e verificação de fluido do câmbio.
  • Interpretar manuais técnicos e diagramas elétricos.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança e ambientais estabelecidos pela montadora.
  • Preencher corretamente OSs, apontando serviços realizados, peças trocadas e tempo aplicado.
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos BYD e manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias.
  • Utilizar corretamente os equipamentos, ferramentas especiais e EPI’s.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • ✔️ - Ensino Médio Completo.
  • ✔️ - Desejável: Curso Técnico em Mecânica Automotiva, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas (SENAI ou equivalente).
  • ✔️ - Tempo: Mínimo de 2 anos em oficina mecânica ou concessionária automotiva.
  • ✔️ - Segmento: Veículos leves.
  • ✔️ - Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com veículos híbridos e elétricos, e vivência em processos padronizados de concessionárias.

Benefícios

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE MARKETING PLENO - FOCO EM COMUNICAÇÃO DE MARCA NA YDUQS.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Analisar dados e indicadores relacionados ao comportamento e à jornada dos alunos, identificando oportunidades para aprimorar a comunicação com a base estudantil;
  • Traduzir campanhas e iniciativas de marketing desenvolvidas para captação em comunicações relevantes também para alunos ativos;
  • Propor ideias, ações e projetos de comunicação voltados ao engajamento, relacionamento e experiência do aluno;
  • Planejar comunicações direcionadas aos alunos, definindo objetivos, mensagens, formatos, canais e públicos de cada ação;
  • Sugerir novos formatos, canais e abordagens de comunicação que ampliem o impacto das mensagens junto aos estudantes;
  • Estruturar o fluxo de comunicação com os alunos, iniciando demandas de envio e articulando com os times responsáveis pela ativação das bases e disparo das comunicações;
  • Solicitar, acompanhar e garantir a execução dos envios de comunicação nos diferentes canais (e-mail, CRM, notificações, entre outros), assegurando a implementação das ações planejadas;
  • Monitorar os resultados das comunicações realizadas e gerar análises e relatórios com insights para otimização das próximas ações;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de marketing, experiência do aluno, acadêmico e demais equipes, garantindo consistência e efetividade na comunicação com esse público.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Jornalismo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Boa capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados e geração de insights;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e habilidade de adaptação de linguagem para diferentes públicos;
  • Interesse por comportamento do consumidor, experiência do aluno e estratégias de comunicação.

Diferenciais

  • Familiaridade com análise de dados e métricas de comunicação;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de CRM, automação de marketing ou plataformas de comunicação;
  • Vivência no segmento educacional.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Barra da Tijuca - RJ (Edifício Montreal)

Jornada de trabalho: 40 horas semanais, de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, com opção de flexibilidade das 8h às 17h.

Na YDUQS você vai encontrar

  • Bolsas de estudo de até 100% para colaboradores, dependentes legais e agregados (pai, mãe e irmãos (as). Permitindo até três bolsas simultâneas;
  • Assistência médica com subsídio integral para o colaborador e parcial para sua família, com o colaborador responsável pela coparticipação;
  • Assistência odontológica opcional, para cuidar da sua saúde bucal;
  • Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição com opção de escolha para se adequar às suas necessidades;
  • Wellhub ou Totalpass para opções flexíveis de academias;
  • Wellz uma plataforma voltada para a saúde mental e emocional dos colaboradores que oferece diversos tipos de acompanhamento, dentre eles acesso a terapias online individuais;
  • Bem-estar e clube de vantagens com programa dedicado e vantagens exclusivas;
  • Dress code flexível para promover a nossa diversidade;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Universidade Corporativa no nosso portal exclusivo, Educare;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento, hoje mais de 60% das vagas são fechadas com processo de seleção interno.

Modelo de trabalho híbrido para todos os escritórios corporativos da companhia.

Horário Flexível, contamos com política de Horário Flexível para colaboradores administrativos do corporativo, com opções de jornada dentro das faixas definidas pela companhia, inclusive para o home office.

title: Vice President, Auditor
description:
Vice President, Auditor – Internal Audit

At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting‑edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.

Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.

We’re seeking a future team member for the role of Vice President, Auditor to join our Internal Audit team. This role is located in Rio de Janeiro.

Responsibilities

  • Participating in risk‑based audits covering Fund Administration, Custody, and Corporate Functions, from end‑to‑end planning through reporting, in line with Internal Audit methodologies and standards.
  • Executing thorough and accurate testing to assess adherence to internal policies, audit standards, and applicable Brazilian and global regulatory requirements.
  • Identifying and promoting opportunities for the use of data analytics, automation, and AI to enhance audit coverage and efficiency.
  • Leads risk‑focused planning, fieldwork and reporting, in accordance with Internal Audit policies, methodologies, and standards to identify meaningful issues, risks and other exposures.
  • Responsible for ensuring testing is adequate and accurate to allow an evaluation of adherence to company policies and procedures, audit methodologies, and all applicable regulations.
  • Demonstrates skills and understanding of businesses and processes through flowcharting, work papers, analysis, issue identification and discussions with management and auditees.
  • Identify meaningful issues impacting business and operations under review, partnering with management to ensure appropriate remedial action has been taken to address the issues identified. Follow‑up of audit actions and test their implementation.
  • Applies advanced analytical problem‑solving skills and leads others in solving complex issues and identifying innovative solutions.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across the Brazil businesses, second line functions, and global Internal Audit teams.
  • Apply knowledge of financial institutions and regulations daily, participate in relevant training, and share insights with the audit team.
  • Contributing to continuous risk assessment and monitoring activities, remaining alert to emerging risks and regulatory developments impacting the Brazil platform.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience or hands‑on interest in applying data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and emerging technologies to audit activities, including the ability to interpret and challenge analytics outputs to drive risk‑based insights.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience required.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
  • Solid experience in Internal Audit or the relevant specialty area (Risk, Compliance, or Controls), with the ability to operate within a global audit framework.
  • Strong knowledge of the financial services industry, including preferably exposure to fund administration and/or custody activities.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) to engage in audits, reporting, and collaboration with international stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate issues and risks to stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
  • Additional skill requirements include understanding of the applied and interpretation of analytics results for Audit, critical thinking and problem solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work collaboratively, and exercise professional judgment.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CIA, CPA, CFA) are preferred.

Benefits and Rewards

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay‑for‑performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

Awards

  • America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
  • World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
  • Most Just Companies, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

About Us

For over 230 years, the people of BNY Mellon have been at the forefront of finance, expanding the financial markets while supporting investors throughout the investment lifecycle. BNY Mellon can act as a single point of contact for clients looking to create, trade, hold, manage, service, distribute or restructure investments & safeguards nearly one‑fifth of the world’s financial assets. BNY Mellon remains one of the safest, most trusted and admired companies. Every day our employees make their mark by helping clients better manage and service their financial assets around the world. Whether providing financial services for institutions, corporations or individual investors, clients count on the people of BNY Mellon across time zones and in 35 countries and more than 100 markets. It’s the collective ambition, innovative thinking and exceptionally focused client service paired with a commitment to doing what is right that continues to set us apart.   • Preocupação com a experiência do usuário e foco total no cliente;
  • Capacidade de alternar entre projetos de diferentes temáticas;
  • Se manter sempre atualizado em relação às atualizações de softwares e novas ferramentas do mercado de Data Science e BI;
  • Ter conhecimento das comunidades web para busca de soluções de desenvolvimento das ferramentas utilizadas.

Desejável, mas não obrigatório

description:
O movimento da vida gera resultados e também resíduos.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor e possível continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

Essa transformação reduz os impactos ambientais causados pela destinação incorreta dos resíduos, promove melhorias diretas na saúde e na qualidade de vida da população carioca e impulsiona a economia circular, conectando pessoas, negócios e meio ambiente.

Missão do cargo:

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Planejamento e Controle para atuar de forma estratégica no processo de FP&A, com forte integração às áreas operacionais e papel essencial no suporte à tomada de decisão da alta administração, por meio de análises econômico-financeiras robustas e modelos financeiros complexos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar e acompanhar os processos de planejamento estratégico, orçamento anual, revisões periódicas (forecast) e controle orçamentário;
  • Desenvolver, estruturar e manter modelos financeiros complexos, incluindo:
  • Projeções financeiras de longo prazo;
  • Modelos de viabilidade econômico-financeira;
  • Simulações de cenários (sensibilidade, stress, upside e downside);
  • Modelos contratuais com múltiplos indexadores e diferentes estruturas de reajuste;
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas operacionais, contratos, engenharia e comercial, traduzindo dados técnicos e operacionais em impactos financeiros claros e acionáveis;
  • Apoiar negociações contratuais, revisões de preços, pleitos e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;
  • Estruturar, acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais;

Requisitos técnicos

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Economia, Administração, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Sólida experiência em Planejamento e Controle Financeiro (FP&A);
  • Domínio avançado de modelagem financeira, especialmente em Excel (ou ferramentas equivalentes), incluindo:
  • Experiência com contratos de longo prazo, concessões ou setores intensivos em capital (infraestrutura, saneamento, resíduos, energia ou similares);

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Experiência em empresas de infraestrutura, saneamento, meio ambiente ou serviços públicos;
  • Vivência com indexadores econômicos, reajustes contratuais e processos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro;

Atuamos na Região Metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.

Estamos presentes de forma estruturada e integrada na cidade do Rio de Janeiro e Região Metropolitana, com unidades operacionais localizadas em pontos estratégicos para o recebimento, transferência, tratamento e destinação ambientalmente adequada dos resíduos coletados.

Nosso compromisso é transformar a forma como os resíduos são geridos, criando valor ambiental, social e econômico a partir do que antes era descartado. Onde outros veem fim, nós enxergamos recomeço: onde tudo tenha a chance de se regenerar.

description:

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in-house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers' compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in-house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in-house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy.

The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment-related and labor-related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in-house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in-house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters.

Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership.

The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective-bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed.

Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers.

Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.

Responds to University officials' request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility.

Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University.

Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems.

Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action.

Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures.

Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies.

Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics.

Ability to participate effectively in fact-finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations.

Ability to articulate the University's position, listen and negotiate effectively.

Superior verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision.

Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines.

Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction.

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience.

All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.
  • Ensure accurate student hiring through FRFs, HAFs, wage-hire classifications, and Workday setup.
  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.
  • Conduct monthly HR and payroll compliance audits including cost allocations, active/inactive positions, and pending transactions.
  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex financial and operational issues clearly.
  • Skilled in Workday Financials, procurement systems, and advanced spreadsheet and reporting tools.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or related field (required)
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience working in higher‑education operations.
  • Workday HR and Workday Finance familiarity.
  • Experience working with academic departments.
  • Administrative operations experience
  • Proficiency in Workday HR required.
  • Proficiency in Workday Finance preferred.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and shared workflow systems.
  • Ability to run reports, analyze personnel data, and maintain accurate records.

title: Product Specialist - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Job Description

Biocomposites is an international medical devices company that engineers, manufactures, and markets world leading products for use in infection management in bone and soft tissue. Based in Keele, UK, it has global operations across Europe, USA, Argentina, Canada, China, and India. Biocomposites is a world leader in the development of innovative calcium compounds and bone cements for surgical use. Its products regenerate bone and target infection risks across a variety of specialties, including musculoskeletal infection, orthopaedics, trauma, spine, foot and ankle, podiatry, and sports injuries. Biocomposites products are now used in over one million procedures per annum and sold in more than 100 countries around the world.

The Role

The Biocomposites Product Specialist’s primary goal is to drive compliant sales growth of the Biocomposites’ product portfolio across our core specialties of orthopedics, trauma, spine, and foot and ankle in priority target accounts. This will be achieved by motivating, educating and supporting the appropriate distributor sales representatives in their sales activities including product training, hospital and surgeon target selection and hands‑on, in‑field sales support. It will also include regularly travelling to target hospitals to engage with surgeons, peri‑operative teams, and hospital staff directly to promote correct product use and adoption. The position reports directly to the Country Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Achieve sales revenue targets by product and specialty in assigned Region.
  • Drive adoption in existing accounts and new users in hospitals within assigned territory. This will be achieved by directly selling to targeted surgeons as well as educating, supporting, and selling through local distribution teams.
  • Exhibit confidence in product knowledge and science to handle competitive threats.
  • Leverage data and local insight to prioritize local territory needs and activities.
  • Utilize business planning tools, data and information to effectively work the territory while achieving goals through set quarterly MBOs.
  • Enhance relationships with key stakeholders within distributor network to influence resource allocation and prioritize focus on Biocomposites’ products.
  • Ensure all distributor sales representatives sell compliantly and use our approved product messaging.
  • Provide continuous training and education to all distributor sales representatives in all vertical markets.
  • Identify and engage new distribution partners in our key vertical markets.
  • Regularly update distributor network on market conditions, challenges, product innovations, competition and pricing, as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Provide surgeon product feedback and identify surgeon challenges and opportunities to inform new product development.
  • Demonstrate OR and product competency to assist surgeons and peri‑operative team with technical guidance.
  • Routinely assist distribution with product expertise and support during sales calls.
  • Provide product in‑services and continuing education seminars to hospital staff.
  • Cultivate relationships with key surgeons, residents, fellows and KOL’s, within geography.
  • Support local customer dinner meetings and scientific exchanges.
  • Support Region Sales Manager in business planning.
  • Achieve quarterly territory Objectives as directed by Region Sales Manager.
  • Clinician and Distributor continuing education via sales trainings, current medical journals and clinical papers.
  • Timely and accurate expense reporting by way of Concur.
  • Ability to travel and conduct overnight stays within the geography as needed.
  • Ability to travel to US headquarters in Wilmington, NC for business meetings as needed.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years of documented medical or B2B sales success grounded in sales process training.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Documented sales success and career progression.
  • Demonstration of competency in presenting technical information.
  • Ability to work with highly diverse groups.
  • Ability to present and educate provided materials.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Documented ability to influence decision makers.
  • Medical Device/Orthopedics Industry experience.
  • Basic knowledge of human anatomy is preferred.
  • Understanding of Hospital OR policy and procedures preferred.
  • Highly organized with exceptional follow‑up.
  • Computer skills, CRM skills, and ability to utilize technology to aid in Territory Management.
  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Resides within the geographical territory.
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable vehicle.
  • Background check and drug screening.

What do we offer?

Competitive salary and benefits! With us, you will receive a competitive salary package and benefits.

We grow talent. At Biocomposites we create opportunities to thrive and grow.

One Biocomposites - team spirit & engagement. Our culture is important, and we strive to create engaged and inclusive global teams that encourage colleagues to share their diverse perspectives and opinions.

Who do we look for?

People Who Are Passionate About What We Do.

People who are open minded to evolving the way we work.

People who can work together to transform outcomes and change lives.

In this role, as an AI Pilot - that's how we refer to this role at Mindrift - you'll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide critical thinking, domain expertise, and quality control to deliver accurate and actionable results. This part‑time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands‑on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real‑world expertise from across the globe.

About The Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Vibe Code specialist, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end‑to‑end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage internal tools (Apify, OpenRouter) alongside custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript‑rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross‑source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $17 per hour equivalent , depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

How To Get Started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine‑tuning AI outputs, you'll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real‑world applications.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in data analysis, AI automation, data engineering, or software development is desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Python web scraping: Build reliable scraping scripts using BeautifulSoup, Selenium (or equivalents) for multi‑level sites, dynamic JS content (infinite scroll, AJAX), and API endpoints via provided proxy.
  • Data extraction expertise: Navigate complex hierarchical structures (regions → companies → details), handling archived pages and varied HTML formats.
  • Data processing: Clean, normalize, and validate scraped data; deliver high‑quality datasets in well‑structured formats (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets) with clear, consistent presentation.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem‑solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self‑directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper‑intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands‑on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance‑based bonus programs that reward high‑quality work and consistent delivery.

Atividades

Principais Atividades:

O(a) colaborador(a) deve realizar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e eficiência energética, contribuindo para a redução de emissões de GEE dos ativos da Companhia.

  • Revisar, atualizar e garantir o cumprimento de procedimentos, templates e padrões de Supply Chain, assegurando alinhamento com diretrizes do Grupo, JOAs e normas internas.
  • Monitorar processos ponta a ponta e riscos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Construir e validar KPIs e dashboards; monitorar KPIs do Métier e preparar informações quando solicitado pelo HQ.
  • Consolidar o Procurement Plan, revisar e acompanhar sua execução, apoiando a equipe de Supply Chain no uso do plano; facilitar o acesso do HQ ao documento.
  • Apoiar o follow up contratual no SAP e ações de melhoria.
  • Atuar como suporte de primeiro nível em SAP MM/WEBI/Power BI.
  • Validar modelos de dados e master data, facilitando o uso do SAP para temas de procurement.
  • Consolidar dados de mercado e avaliações de fornecedores, incluindo realização de Due Diligence; apoiar compradores nas avaliações.
  • Participar do desenvolvimento e manutenção de um banco de dados de fornecedores de referência.
  • Executar SOX, acompanhar DOA e regras de governança; preparar materiais e apoiar exercícios de auditoria.
  • Organizar treinamentos, onboarding e canais de comunicação da área de Supply Chain.
  • Facilitar comunicação interna entre Supply Chain e outras entidades da afiliada para temas de procurement.

Responsabilidades

  • Manter procedimentos e templates padronizados para assegurar práticas consistentes de Supply Chain.
  • Monitorar processos ponta a ponta para identificar melhorias e riscos operacionais.
  • Fornecer KPIs e dashboards para garantir visibilidade clara de performance.
  • Realizar análises com SAP e ferramentas de relatórios para suportar decisões.
  • Garantir acurácia dos dados e conformidade ao validar master data, regras de governança e requisitos de auditoria.
  • Executar Due Diligence de fornecedores, avaliando integridade, conformidade e indicadores de risco.

Perfil do Candidato

  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Data Science ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: 5+ anos na indústria de O&G, com no mínimo 3 anos em Contratos & Procurement.
  • Competências técnicas: Gestão avançada de materiais; conhecimento de materiais EP (Perfuração, Completação, Subsea, HSE); sólido entendimento de MRP e MAP (contabilização de estoque).
  • Sistemas: SAP MM avançado, WebI, Power BI avançado, Excel avançado; familiaridade com Ariba e conceito UNISOL é um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Português fluente e inglês avançado.
  • Competências pessoais: Análise e resolução de problemas; planejamento e priorização sob pressão; trabalho em equipe; rigor e atenção aos detalhes; boa organização; comunicação eficaz e habilidade de influenciar stakeholders; forte capacidade de apresentação.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Functions

To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services.

Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation-Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co-occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.
  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.
  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine, Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.
  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow-up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.
  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow-up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.
  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.
  • Reviews all initial client bio-psychosocial assessments and reassessments.
  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.
  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.
  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.
  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.
  • Competence in both oral and written English.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.
  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$46,700 - $52,700

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.

The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.

The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.

Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.

Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.

Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.

title: Assessor Científico I | Pesquisa | IDOR RJ
description:
Descrição

Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.

Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.

Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.

A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Requisitos

  • Curso Superior Completo;
  • Competência em Ferramentas de Pesquisa Digital.
  • Habilidade em Redação e Produção de Conteúdo e apresentações.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de videoconferência, colaboração online e mensagens;
  • Desejável vivência na área científica, preferencialmente na área da Saúde;
  • Desejável cursos e conhecimentos em Boas Práticas clínicas, laboratoriais e científicas.
  • Desejável conhecimento sobre resoluções éticas regulatórias aplicadas à pesquisa.
  • Desejável vivência em atividades de suporte administrativo, controles, organização de informações;
  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário do idioma inglês para lidar com documentos científicos e regulatórios.

Atividades

  • Buscar editais e oportunidades de fomento e encaminhar para setores envolvidos.
  • Apoiar com dados, figuras e redação, a elaboração de documentos e projetos técnico-científicos.
  • Atuar na elaboração de relatórios técnico-científicos de andamento dos projetos e prestação de contas para as agências reguladoras, agências de fomento e para fins de leis de incentivo fiscal.
  • Revisar técnicas e procedimentos de projetos, para assegurar o cumprimento dos protocolos, requisitos das agências de fomento, patrocinadores e de exigências éticas e regulatórias.
  • Manter os documentos de pesquisa tanto em formatos físicos quanto digitais organizados, categorizados e de fácil acesso para a equipe do projeto.
  • Atuar para que os dados, documentos, amostras e informações relacionadas aos projetos de pesquisa recebam armazenamento, confidencialidade e descarte adequados.
  • Cadastrar e atualizar informações Institucionais, sobre projetos e grupos de pesquisa, em plataformas internas e externas, com a anuência da Diretoria.
  • Inserir e atualizar dados em sistemas de gestão, mantendo a precisão e integridade, além de acompanhar e relatar o progresso das atividades.
  • Monitorar métricas, levantar informações e analisar dados para atender indicadores de interesse da Diretoria.
  • Participar de colaborações científicas com outras instituições, laboratórios e pesquisadores, de acordo com os interesses da Diretoria.
  • Participar de reuniões, workshops, cursos, aulas e congressos de interesse da Diretoria.
  • Prestar suporte na preparação de apresentações.
  • Participar do planejamento e execução de projetos de extensão e divulgação científica do IDOR.
  • Organizar recursos, orçamentos e infraestrutura de pesquisa, incluindo equipamentos, material e pessoal.
  • Oferecer suporte para pesquisadores e equipe sobre procedimentos operacionais técnicos e administrativos.
  • Solicitar e acompanhar documentos, orçamentos ou projetos durante a tramitação em outros setores e Instituições.
  • Capacitar/orientar o Administrador de Banco de Dados nas atividades da função.

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

A área de Customer Experience da Leve Saúde atua de forma estratégica na melhoria contínua da jornada do beneficiário, conectando dados, operação e transformação.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Processos e Projetos Pleno para atuar no time de Customer Experience (CX), sendo responsável por conduzir iniciativas de melhoria da jornada do cliente, com foco em gerar impacto real para o cliente e para o negócio.

Procuramos uma pessoa com perfil mão na massa, organizado e protagonista , que tenha autonomia para conduzir projetos, navegar entre áreas e transformar problemas em soluções práticas.

A Leve é uma empresa em crescimento acelerado, por isso, mais do que seguir um escopo rígido, esperamos alguém disposto a construir, adaptar e evoluir junto com a área , com potencial para assumir desafios cada vez mais complexos ao longo do tempo.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir projetos estruturantes de melhoria da jornada do cliente, do diagnóstico à implementação;
  • Gerenciar iniciativas utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e etc),incluindo gestão de backlog e priorização a partir de metodologia;
  • Traduzir dados e insights da Voz do Cliente em planos de ação estruturados;
  • Apoiar na gestão de mudanças, reduzindo o impacto no cliente e garantindo a adoção das melhorias pelas áreas envolvidas;
  • Mapear e redesenhar processos e jornadas do cliente, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conduzir workshops e rituais de projetos (brainstorming, planning, sprint e reviews);
  • Articular com diferentes áreas (operação, rede, relacionamento, tecnologia, etc.) para garantir a execução e sucesso das entregas;
  • Elaborar materiais com storytelling claro e objetivo, evidenciando resultados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores e garantir a mensuração dos resultados das iniciativas implementadas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas, incluindo inteligência artificial, para otimizar análises, organização e execução das atividades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos, Processos, Tecnologia, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e melhoria de processos;
  • Vivência na gestão de squads, aplicação de metodologias ágeis e condução de projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Forte capacidade de planejamento, organização, gestão de riscos, acompanhamento de cronogramas e comunicação com stakeholders diversos;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e apoiar na geração de insights;
  • Conhecimento em mapeamento e redesenho de processos/jornadas;
  • Habilidade de construção de materiais executivos com storytelling;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Pacote Google, Office, Jira, Bizagi e Miro.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Customer Experience ou Jornada do cliente;
  • Vivência em empresas de saúde ou operações complexas;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de experiência (NPS, CSAT, churn);
  • Experiência com gestão de mudanças estruturadas;
  • Familiaridade com uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia de trabalho;
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital, automação dE processos ou implantação de tecnologias.

title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully.
  • Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment.
  • Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms.
  • Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system.
  • Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery.
  • Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness.
  • Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders.
  • Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required.

Your profile

Education / Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties.
  • Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi-venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies.
  • Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Leadership and team management
  • Operational planning and execution
  • Stakeholder management
  • Problem solving and decision making
  • Communication and coordination
  • Attention to detail
  • Risk management mindset

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel to host cities.
  • Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time.
  • Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred.
  • Proven track record of developing and leading teams.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

  • Support operational and administrative management in preventing incidents and mitigating impacts on employees, contractors, suppliers, clients, the community, the environment, and the company’s image and assets.
  • Assist leadership in applying incident investigation techniques according to MODEC procedures to determine root causes and define appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
  • Be able to develop and review bridging documents between MODEC and its contractors.

Requisitos e qualificações
